dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Yates River Area (NTS 84N/NE) (discontinuous permafrost features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the permafrost polygon features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 552, Surficial Geology of the Yates River Area (NTS 84N/NE).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Yates River Area (NTS 84N/NE) (GIS data, permafrost polygon features)
